author: Inside Edition
description: Police say students drove to the home of math teacher, Jason Hughes, to drape toilet paper around his property in what was supposed to be a good-natured prank. The teacher came out of the home and reportedly slipped on the wet ground before falling in front of a car and getting run over. Police say the students stopped and tried to help him until an ambulance arrived. The teacher was pronounced dead at the hospital. Hughes' wife said she "supports getting the charges dropped for all involved.”
title: Wife Of Teacher Killed In Prank Wants Charges Dropped Against Students

author: Inside Edition
description: Cops say an ISIS-inspired terrorist tossed a bomb in front of the mayor of New York's mansion. Two bombs failed to explode. Police chased down the suspect. The drama unfolded outside Gracie Mansion, New York City Mayor Zohran Mamdani's official residents where far-right anti-Islam protestors clashed with counter-protesters. Now there is fear that ISIS terror cells may target Sunday's Oscars. Security expert Kent Moyer spoke with Inside Edition amid preparations for the ceremony.
title: Fear Over Safety At Oscars After Bomb Thrown Outside Gracie Mansion

author: Inside Edition
description: A shooter opened fire from an assault rifle at Rihanna's Beverly Hills mansion Sunday night, police say. Bullet holes pierced the singer's front security gate and her RV. Authorities are identifying the alleged shooter as 35-year-old Ivanna Ortiz of Orlando, Florida. She has a history of misdemeanor arrests. The 14-time Grammy award winner was not injured. It is not known if Rihanna's partner ASAP Rocky and their three children were also home at the time of attack.
title: Florida Woman Used Assault Rifle To Shoot Rihanna's Home, Cops Say

author: Inside Edition
description: A car swerved all over a highway and slammed into a wall. The young husband and wife in the car behind sped up to see what was happening. The driver appeared to be passed out at the wheel. Rene Villarreal-Albe, 29, decided to perform a pit maneuver, which is usually done by police to stop suspects from getting away. Villarreal-Albe and his wife Andrea spoke with Inside Edition. It turned out, authorities say, the stricken driver had suffered a medical emergency and was unconscious.
title: 'Highway Hero' Uses Pit Maneuver After Driver Loses Consciousness

author: Inside Edition
description: Some spring breakers are going to the airport braced for chaos. Long Lines at TSA checkpoints across the nation have many spooked. It was busy at Newark Airport in New Jersey Monday. TSA now recommends getting to the airport three hours before your flight, but if you are flying out of Houston, the recommendation is five hours. Inside Edition spoke to travel expert Laura Begley Bloom for tips to make travel easier.
title: Travelers Brace For Airport Chaos Ahead Of Spring Break

author: Inside Edition
description: This woman's speed was way off, according to Police in Orlando, Florida. They posted video of a traffic stop to their Facebook page because of the unusual excuse this driver provided for exceeding the speed limit. She told the officer who stopped her that she had a stomach ache. Officials say she was recorded driving at 136 miles per hour. She was arrested for dangerous excess of speeds. Inside Edition Digital’s Mara Montalbano has more.
title: Woman Caught Speeding At 136 MPH Tells Cop She Had A Stomach Ache

author: Inside Edition
description: He may be in fourth grade, but his sense of fashion is on a masters' level. Max Alexander says his age won't stop him from taking the next step in his career as a designer. He's bound for Paris Fashion Week where he will be the youngest designer to ever hold a show at the event. KCBS caught up with him at his Los Angeles studio, where he was packing up the designs he will debut. Inside Edition Digital’s Mara Montalbano has more.
title: 10-Year-Old Is Youngest Fashion Designer To Ever Show At Paris Fashion Week

author: Inside Edition
description: The "Kill Bill" star has not spoken publicly about her six-year relationship with JFK Jr until now.
title: Daryl Hannah Lashes Out Over 'Love Story' Depiction #shorts
